It is my first time here. How does booking work, and do I need an account?

DeskAtlas

On the public website, select a workspace, date, time, and duration, then enter your name and email to submit a request; no customer account is required. After submission, you will receive payment instructions and a private link to upload proof of payment within 60 minutes. Administrator review follows payment, and a confirmed booking is only established by an explicit final confirmation showing the actual physical unit and schedule.

You

Can I take video calls there, and do you have Wi-Fi and power outlets?

DeskAtlas

Video calls are permitted only in rooms advertised as soundproof (Sky Den for one person, Sky Booth for two); they are prohibited at quiet shared desks (Think Spot, Focus Pod, Flow Row, Design Dock, Power Bar, Collab Nook). Wi-Fi is available, but no speed or uptime guarantee is established. Power outlets are not guaranteed at every physical unit; staff must verify a functional outlet at the specific seat before booking.
